page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-96-metal is a bare-metal server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It is configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture. The system features 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network and external storage interfaces must be attached virtually, as there is no bundled local storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on an arm64 architecture, this bare-metal instance offers high resource density for memory-intensive workloads. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it highly suitable for large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and data caching layers. The arm64 architecture provides a power-efficient alternative to traditional x86 platforms, delivering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that can leverage ARM-native compilation.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-96-metal is an arm64-based bare-metal server designed for memory-intensive workloads. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high-density memory allocation of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU accelerators, requiring external block storage for data persistence. Operating on an energy-efficient arm64 architecture, it provides a cost-effective hardware profile for memory-bound applications. The server is well-suited for hosting large-scale databases, in-memory data stores, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines that benefit from dedicated bare-metal execution and ARM-native optimization.
